Date: Saturday, June 6, 2026

Execution order (follow this exactly):
1. Study the reference pages first — Read security-settings and my-profile (.html + .scss) plus the current change-bank-account.page and linkplaid.component.html for the illustration card so the new UI matches the design system and reuses existing card / header / icon patterns.
2. Map the existing logic — Note every binding the template uses (currentBankAccount, isLoading, isPlaidReady, statusMessage, openPlaid()) so the redesign keeps the Plaid flow and step-up PIN check working untouched.
3. Rebuild the chosen direction — Implement the selected mockup (with any of your per-option notes) in the new HTML + SCSS: current-account card, redesigned CTA, and the Plaid trust messaging.
4. Build all four UX states — Loading, empty (no account linked), error + retry, and success — each designed, not placeholder, so no state looks unfinished.
5. Verify & check for regressions — Run npx tsc --noEmit (exits 0),  then run the verifier agent.

Andrew's Answers:
FRED-124: Is this a pure visual reskin of the existing single-account swap, or do you also want account-management features added (e.g. showing multiple linked accounts, set-default, remove)? My recommendation is a pure reskin today and a separate story for multi-account management — answer "reskin only" to lock that, or describe what you want added.
            Required: reskin only

Design feedback per option:
Design feedback — Option C — Hero-Led: i like the hero-led page. this is similar to how i have the tab3 (settings) page all rendered where i have the blue header at the top and the rest is white down below over top of the blue. the only addition i want is to have the illustration card from linkplaid added to this page. it should show that card under chase checking and then under the illustration card it should show the connect a new bank card. also, take a look at how the ion header in security settings is centered and not left-aligned

Proceed with implementation.
